note: British Virgin Islands, read on the Government of the Virgin Islands' service pages (gov.vg) on 2026-10-30. A non-belonger needs a work permit from the Department of Labour and Workforce Development to work (Labour Code 2010, s. 170, employment or self-employment); permits are for a specific role, employer and timeframe (work for the sponsor); the employer applies on the Labour Management System after advertising the post for two weeks, the worker abroad or already in the territory changing employer (either); a new permit lets its holder enter and work for up to three years, subject to renewal or extension; it costs '$50 - $200' (a range, so no fee is kept) and takes four to six weeks (6 kept). Residence Status, under the Immigration and Passport Act, asks ten years' continuous residence (absences of at most a year at a time and 90 days a year), good character and integration; its application fee is $250, the Immigration Board reviewing and Cabinet deciding (10 kept as the work permit's years to it). Belonger status and naturalisation aren't written; the 2025 immigration fee schedule (Immigration and Passport (Amendment) Regulations 2025) is in an attachment not read.

sources.title: GOV.VG, Apply For a New Work Permit
sources.said: A work permit is required for any non-belonger seeking employment in the Territory. ... Work permits are issued for specific roles, employers, and timeframes, and are subject to immigration and labour regulations. ... $50 - $200 ... Four (4) to Six(6) Weeks providing all the relevant documents have been uploaded ... You reside within the territory and is changing employer ... A new work permit allows a non-belonger to enter the Virgin Islands and work for a period not exceeding ... three (3) years ... , which may be subject to renewal or extension.

sources.title: GOV.VG, Apply for Residence Status in the Virgin Islands
sources.said: Residence Status allows a person to be recognised as a lawful resident of the Virgin Islands under the Immigration and Passport Act. ... Live in the Virgin Islands for 10 years in a row without being away for more than one year at a time. ... Application fee of $250.00 that is non-refundable
